_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics and neutral momentum/funding/F&G leave no confirmed breaker, so the skilled call is hold the current Hope band rather than force a directional rung change.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicitly HOLD/medium inside coil; narrative is flow-descriptive only and silent on forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, 30d momentum near 50, funding ~neutral, fear_greed 50-65, no vol expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: thrust up (momentum/funding lift, F&G through ~70 into Optimism/Disbelief edge) or breakdown (VIX/skew expansion, funding flip toward Anxiety)
